nm PRICE IB last 638.02 at 2026-10-30 23:47Z (feed status FROZEN = after close), prior close 635.70, +0.36%; 52w range 463.80-644.20 (a new 52w high at the last month bar: high 644.24); month of Oct 2026 closed 638.01 vs 551.47 end Sep (+15.7%), i.e. the price jumped around the 2026-10-29 results. IB has no split; quarterly dividend 0.87 USD (ex 2026-10-09, pay 2026-11-09), raised from 0.76 (about +14%).

nm AV RATE LIMIT 2026-11-01: INCOME_STATEMENT answered 'standard API rate limit is 25 requests per day'; probed once, BALANCE_SHEET, CASH_FLOW and EARNINGS_ESTIMATES not called, no retry. FMP statements/analyst denied on this plan (session_capabilities). Second statement source therefore missing: reconciliation is against the filings themselves.

nm RECONCILIATION FY2025 vs 10-K (reading/10k_full.txt): revenue 32,791, operating income 18,897, net income 14,968, diluted EPS 16.52, diluted shares 906, CFO 17,648: all equal the prefetch pf_ facts, no difference. SBC 597 (10-K) not in the prefetch: added as nm_sbc_fy2025. Capex: prefetch capex 489 = purchases of property and equipment only; capitalized software 726 is a separate investing line (total 1,215), so FCF defined as CFO minus capex(PP&E) is overstated by 726 versus CFO minus both lines.

nm RECONCILIATION Q3 2026 vs 10-Q filed 2026-10-29: revenue 9,807, operating income 5,862, net income 4,628 equal the prefetch quarter facts; diluted EPS 5.28 (Q3) and 14.59 (9M), diluted shares 876 (Q3) / 884 (9M); 9M CFO 11,859 vs 12,646 a year earlier (-6%, while 9M net income +18%: working-capital/settlement timing, check in the 10-Q liquidity section); 9M SBC 525; 9M capex PP&E 667 (vs 377) plus capitalized software 474 (vs 548). Q3 standalone CFO/capex not derived (needs the 1H 10-Q; gap).

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch roic_last 0.98 (average 0.87) uses invested capital = equity + debt - cash with FY2025 equity 7.7B: equity is depressed by buybacks (11.7B in 2025) and dividends, so ROIC near 100% reflects a tiny capital base, not a measured return on operating assets; restricted cash 564 (2026-09-30, 561 at year end) is outside cash 10,147; total debt rose to 23.9B at 2026-09-30 from 19.0B at year end (+4.9B) and cash fell to 10.1B from 10.6B, so invested capital is up sharply in 2026 and ROIC will decline mechanically; investments that are not cash, operating leases and settlement assets/obligations were not adjusted. Read as 'very high, capital-light', not as a precise figure.

nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY trailing GAAP diluted P/E (month-end price over trailing EPS interpolated between fiscal year EPS 6.37, 8.76, 10.22, 11.83, 13.89, 16.52 and TTM 19.11): low 27.5 (2026-05) median 35.6 high 43.5 (2022-01) now 33.4 (638.02 / 19.11; 38.6 on FY2025 EPS 16.52) years 2021-11 to 2026-10 sources nm_hist_ib, nm_price_ib, pf_eps_diluted_fy2020..fy2025, nm_eps_diluted_ttm_2026q3. Approximate (interpolated EPS, no quarterly EPS series). Today's multiple sits just under the 5-year median after a 16% month. Forward P/E: no usable post-results consensus (see CONSENSUS); on a pre-results web FY2027 EPS 22.51 it would be about 28, attributed and stale. Not a peak-earnings quarter x 4 case: net income rose each quarter, EPS Q3 5.28.

nm CONSENSUS none registered: AV EARNINGS_ESTIMATES not called (rate limit), FMP analyst denied. One WebSearch returned only pre-Q3 (before 2026-10-29) excerpts with disagreeing figures and no stated provider date: FY2026 EPS 19.52-19.61 (24 analysts, one page) and 20.55 (Chartmill, 47 analysts, 2026-10-18); FY2027 EPS 22.51 (Barchart) / 22.27 (Zacks); FY2026 revenue 37.0B (28 analysts); Q3 2026 EPS estimates 5.13 or 5.31 versus reported 5.28; Q2 2026 reported 5.04 vs 4.77 consensus. These are opinion/expectation excerpts, not citable rows; revenue and EPS consensus after the 2026-10-29 report remain a gap. Analyst price targets on those pages not used.

nm TRACK RECORD no guidance_track rows: the eight saved earnings releases (2025-01-30 to 2026-10-29) contain no outlook paragraph (grep for outlook/expect/low double digits found nothing); Mastercard gives its outlook on the earnings call (gather_documents' transcript). Reported revenue growth for context: Q2 2026 +14% (12% currency-neutral), Q3 2026 revenue 9,807 vs 8,602 (+14.0%). Guided midpoint vs actual not computable here; gap handed to gather_documents/analyst.
